blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every country collects taxes. Taxes are money that people and companies pay to the government. The government uses this money to build roads, run hospitals, pay teachers and keep the country working.

For a company like Czarnikow, taxes are important. When you sell sugar in Brazil and buy freight in the UK, you follow different tax rules in different countries. Knowing the basics helps you work with the finance team and avoid mistakes.

In this lesson, we learn the simple words of taxes. We also learn how to talk about them clearly in English.

items.q: What are taxes, according to the text?
options: Money that the government pays to companies
Money that people and companies pay to the government
A gift from the finance team
items.why: "Taxes are money that people and companies pay to the government."

items.q: What does the government do with tax money?
options: It gives it back to big companies
It keeps it in a safe
It builds roads, runs hospitals and pays teachers
items.why: "The government uses this money to build roads, run hospitals, pay teachers…"

items.q: Why are taxes important for a company like Czarnikow?
options: Because it does not pay taxes
Because taxes are free for companies
Because it only sells in the UK
Because it works in different countries with different tax rules
items.why: "When you sell sugar in Brazil and buy freight in the UK, you follow different tax rules in different countries."

items.q: The text suggests that knowing about taxes helps you…
options: work with the finance team and avoid mistakes
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que "knowing the basics helps you work with the finance team and avoid mistakes".

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely AGREE with?
options: Every country uses the same tax rules
Understanding tax words in English is useful for the job
Taxes are only a problem for the government
items.why: Inferência: a lição existe para ensinar as palavras de impostos em inglês para o trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando os impostos a um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. Let me tell you something simple about taxes here in the UK.

Many people think a tax is just a bill. You get the number, you pay it, and you are angry. But I see it in another way. A tax is a relationship between the company and the country.

Think about it. We work here. We use the roads. Our people go to hospitals. Their children go to schools. All of this comes from public services, and public services need money. That money is tax. So when we pay, we contribute to the place where we live and work.

Good companies understand this. They pay on time. They are honest with the finance team. They do not try to hide. This is about fairness, and fairness builds trust.

My advice is simple. Do not think of tax as an enemy. Think of it as your part of the deal. Learn the basic words, ask questions, and work with the finance team. If you do that, taxes will never be a big problem for you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does James see a tax?
options: As a gift from the government
As a relationship between the company and the country
items.why: "A tax is a relationship between the company and the country."

items.q: According to James, where does the money for public services come from?
items.why: "public services need money. That money is tax."

items.q: What do good companies do, according to James?
options: They pay on time and are honest
They try to hide from the finance team
They pay only when they are angry
items.why: "They pay on time. They are honest with the finance team. They do not try to hide."

items.q: James says fairness builds trust. This suggests that…
options: trust is not important for business
paying taxes honestly gives a company a good name
items.why: Inferência: se justiça gera confiança, ser honesto com os impostos melhora a reputação da empresa.

items.q: What is James's main advice to the new colleague?
options: Pay as little tax as possible
Do not think of tax as an enemy
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Do not think of tax as an enemy. Think of it as your part of the deal."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Companies pay a tax to the government every year." A tax is…
items.why: Tax = imposto: dinheiro pago ao governo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The government uses tax money to ___ schools and hospitals."
items.why: "Run" schools/hospitals = manter em funcionamento (como no texto: "run hospitals").

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Roads and hospitals are examples of a ___."
items.why: Public service = serviço público, como estradas e hospitais.

items.q: "Everyone must contribute — people and companies." To contribute means to…
items.why: To contribute = contribuir, dar a sua parte.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Paying tax on time is a question of ___ — everyone pays their part."
items.why: Fairness = justiça: todos pagam a sua parte de forma justa.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem em conversas sobre impostos e finanças. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please pay the tax on time." To pay on time means to…
items.why: Pay on time = pagar na data certa, sem atraso.

items.q: "The finance team will sign off on the tax report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Some companies try to get away with paying no tax." To get away with means to…
options: do something wrong without being caught
items.why: Get away with = escapar de algo errado sem sofrer consequência.

items.q: "Let's work with the finance team on this." To work with someone means to…
items.why: Work with = trabalhar em conjunto com alguém.

items.q: "We must keep up with the tax rules in each country." To keep up with means to…
options: stay informed and not fall behind
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar, manter-se atualizado e não ficar para trás.
